validation_notes: The broad CLI run exposed pre-extension fake availability replies; fixtures now explicitly return owner-disabled apps policy. The route assertion requires apps=1. The production policy-read requirement was retained.
The first isolated broad command omitted normal HOME; the final run preserves the normal environment and isolates Wrangler via os.homedir/XDG paths. No protected configuration was inspected.

A stale-media red-test fixture initially left its matrix boundary unfaked. Its owned processes were stopped while in the busy wait, with no VM launch or guest output; the empty owned result directory was removed. All final media controls use a fake matrix and temporary bench path.
The first legacy apps mutant attempt hit its unchanged 180-second subprocess timeout after a green 564-test baseline; the final retry uses the same timeout and thresholds.

The full broker run used a changing index while receipt files were staged. Three tree parity failures were reproduced as index drift, then passed with a fixed index. The unchanged deep-path timing control passed alone at nice 19. Raw counts are retained; this receipt does not claim the initial full run green.

An unmodified origin/next control also fails only the same deep-path timing testcase with 50 ms limits (18/19); no timing threshold or tree-key code was changed. A fresh-checkout CI run remains required for the draft head.

The collector now explicitly requests TAP like existing harnesses; all 38 variants pass in GITHUB_ACTIONS=true mode. Two old app-policy assertions were aligned with the required MEDIA result; all 174 KFCI tests pass.
